text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, about afterwards.
There's somewhere I'd like to stop by—

text_block_list.name: Enthusiastic Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Um, you're Duramente-san, right?
Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Enthusiastic Reporter
text_block_list.text: I'm with “Weekly Hit Sports”! Would you mind if I interviewed you?

text_block_list.name: Nearby Fans
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? Duramente?
Whoa, it really is Duramente!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was her day off, but an impromptu interview started out of nowhere!
I need to protect her before it turns into a commotion...!
choice_data_list: I'm sorry, but please contact us in advance for interviews...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...No, Trainer.
It's fine. I'll take the interview."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If I am to always be the "strongest"—
then living up to the fans' expectations is part of that duty.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began the ambush interview.
I watched over Duramente
from a short distance away, but...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
“—My sights are set on one thing alone: being the ‘strongest’.
My next race is no different. There are no exceptions.”

text_block_list.name: Enthusiastic Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great~!
All prepped up—got your strategy set for the next race too?
Whisper it to me, pretty please~!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...I cannot disclose that.
Please look forward to the day itself."

text_block_list.name: Enthusiastic Reporter
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, your guard is as solid as ever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was worried about the sudden interview, but she remained completely composed.
Just as I thought my worries were unfounded...!

text_block_list.name: Enthusiastic Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...Then tell me the secret to your strength!
You've been sharpening your skills even more lately, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: The secret to strength. Lately, it's been...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: “Guts Smash! 3 Tears-Filled Years”.

text_block_list.name: Enthusiastic Reporter
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: It's a movie I watched with my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
A classic sports drama film about
an athlete and a coach pursuing their dream.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Trainer and I would sit in adjacent chairs, enjoying the same story together—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: And then, we climbed a mountain too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The view earned after conquering the mountain path
was even more magnificent than usual.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Sharing sensibilities improves communication.
It directly leads to more effective training.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Therefore, the secret to victory is—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: It's about sharing my emotions with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Enthusiastic Reporter
text_block_list.text:
In other words... the driving force behind their growth
is deepening their bond by doing the same things!

text_block_list.name: Enthusiastic Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Then... please let us accompany you
on today's outing for an interview!

text_block_list.name: Nearby Fans
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm curious too...!
I bet the two of them are going to take on something amazing!"
choice_data_list: I-it's not that grand of an outing—!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, but this is as far as we go today.
—Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: ...Welcome.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Classic Cafe. It is our place of relaxation.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: We should be able to relax here, just the two of us, right?
choice_data_list: I was wondering where you were taking me...
Looks like you enjoyed taking all those detours more than expected!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
She must have built up some real grit.
Her daily training is producing great results.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you tomorrow too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You seemed on edge during the interview.
It might be good to take a breather here.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...If you'd prefer the mountains, just let me know.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Of course. There are discoveries to be made outside the track as well.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Let's keep tasting and experiencing the same things together.
